skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the role, nature, and functions of social security, including programs within the social security system such as social insurance, healthcare, social assistance, poverty reduction funds, commercial insurance, and related services.
Apply knowledge on social security and the pillars of the social security system to enhance awareness and improve state management mechanisms.
Develop skills for synthesis, analysis, and systematic thinking; ability to organize and manage resources for specialized professional activities in social security management.
Demonstrate independence in work, personal responsibility, and responsibility towards group work.
